headline: Preprint reports data-composition scaling laws for synthetic tool-use agent training
summary: An Apple-affiliated preprint introduces SynthAPI, a pipeline that generates executable tool-use environments with configurable diversity across tools, tasks and database states. The authors report experiments spanning 458,752 tasks and 849 Qwen3.5 models, and a composition-aware scaling law with lower held-out error than a task-count-only fit. They also report benchmark gains over selected prior methods, while noting that some comparisons use different training regimes. The study is confined to synthetic, research-only simulations; its authors say transfer beyond this single synthesis pipeline is not established.
